title: Thirdparty Dependencies via Setup Script Only
description: All 35 thirdparty dependencies are managed exclusively by scripts/setup.ps1. The script handles: git clone --depth 1, .git directory removal, junk cleanup (docs/tests/examples), patch application, prebuilt binary downloads (DXC, Agility SDK, Slang), and verification. This ensures consistent versions, applied patches, and clean state across all developers.
example:
# To add a new library:
# 1. Edit scripts/setup.ps1 — add clone/download section
# 2. Delete runtime/thirdparty/<lib> if exists
# 3. Run: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup.ps1
# 4. Verify: cd runtime && zig build
whenToUse: When adding a new thirdparty library. When updating a library version. When fixing a bug in a thirdparty lib (add a patch file).
whenNotToUse: Never bypass this — no manual git clone, curl, or wget into runtime/thirdparty/.
